registry.description: The Docker registry to pull the image from

port.description: The port for Outline to listen on, also used as the container port and health check target

defaultLanguage.description: The default interface language - see translate.getoutline.com for available codes

value.description: A hex-encoded 32-byte random key, e.g. generated with `openssl rand -hex 32` - ignored if `existingSecret.name` is set, auto-generated if left empty

type.description: The storage backend for images and attachments. Valid values are `local` or `s3`

uploadMaxSize.description: The maximum allowed size, in bytes, for an uploaded attachment

acl.description: The S3 ACL applied to uploaded objects

cert.description: Base64-encoded certificate for HTTPS termination inside the container - not needed when SSL is terminated at the Ingress, as is the default for this chart
